title: A localized 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND is cacheable by default but carries no Vary: Accept-Language
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a contract review finding outside its PR's diff) · Source: fleet (PR #37813 contract review 7210823764, S1; card #37737 item 6)

## What happens

`404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, raised by `GET /data/:object/:id` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-data-crud.ts:1016`), carries a `userMessage` in the caller's `Accept-Language` (`packages/core/src/utils/record-not-found.ts:75`). It sends no `Vary: Accept-Language`. A `404` is cacheable by default (RFC 9110 §15.1), so a shared cache can serve one caller's language to another.

PR #37813 adds `Vary: Accept-Language` to the ten localized `501`s in runtime, which answers #37737 item 6 for those only. This card carries the rest of item 6.

## Expected

Every localized refusal that is cacheable by default carries `Vary: Accept-Language`. Today that is the `404` above; the card checks whether any other cacheable status (`410`, `405`, `414`, `421`, `451`) carries a localized message.

## Done when

- [ ] `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` sends `Vary: Accept-Language`, through both senders (the Hono adapter and the dispatcher plugin), appended to any existing `Vary`.
- [ ] A test pins the header on the `404`.
- [ ] Any other default-cacheable localized refusal found is covered the same way, or listed on this card.

Grade: area:ux · bug · reach: a shared cache in front of a multi-language deployment · evidence: read (the two lines above), not run
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: S
